Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring notice to patients for certain charges at a health care facility.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to billing practices for health care services;adding a new section to chapter 70.01 RCW; and providing an effectivedate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Prior to the delivery of services, a health care facility thatcharges a facility fee shall provide a notice to any patient of theitems that comprise the facility fee and an estimate of the potentialcost to the patient. (2) Each health care facility must post prominently in locationseasily accessible to and visible by patients, including its web site,a statement that the health care facility shall provide patients withthe notice in subsection (1) of this section. (3) Nothing in this section applies to laboratory services, imagingservices, or other ancillary health services not provided by staffemployed by the health care facility. (4) No health care facility may charge a facility fee that exceedsthe amount that would be determined to be the allowed amount for the p. 1 SHB 2582same service under the federal medicare program, Title XVIII of thesocial security act, (42 U.S.C. Sec. 1395 et seq., as amended) pursuantto medicare reimbursement policies for providerbased organizations. (5) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Health care facility" means the site of an oncampus clinic orprovider office or offcampus clinic or provider office that is ownedby a hospital licensed under chapter 70.41 RCW or a health system thatoperates one or more hospitals licensed under chapter 70.41 RCW. (b) "Facility fee" means any charge by a health care facility inaddition to a professional fee for physicians' services that isintended to cover building, electronic medical records systems,billing, and other administrative and operational expenses.
